levels.title: Stable Contract
levels.changePolicy: No breaking structural changes inside the same contract version.
levels.consumerGuidance: Safe for agent runtimes, CI gates, examples, and integrations to depend on.

levels.title: Preview Contract
levels.changePolicy: Compatible additions are preferred, but documented reshaping may occur before promotion to stable.
levels.consumerGuidance: Safe for experiments and guarded integrations that pin package versions.

levels.title: Experimental Contract
levels.changePolicy: Shape and semantics may change while the workstream is being discovered.
levels.consumerGuidance: Use for fixtures, research, and opt-in trials; do not assume long-lived compatibility.
